name: ai-data-analyst-agent
description: AI data analyst using Streamlit, Groq, DuckDB, and secure SQL validation. Upload CSV files and ask questions in plain English.

paragraphs: An AI-powered data analysis application that allows users to upload CSV datasets and ask analytical questions using natural language.

The application converts natural-language questions into DuckDB-compatible SQL using Groq, validates the generated SQL through an independent security layer, executes the validated query with DuckDB, and presents the results with tables, visualizations, and AI-generated explanations.
This project demonstrates how generative AI can be integrated into a data-analysis workflow without giving the language model direct control over database execution.
features: Ask questions about an uploaded dataset using plain English instead of writing SQL manually.
The application dynamically generates SQL based on the uploaded dataset's schema.
After a successful analysis, ask a follow-up such as "Now show only the top 2." The planner receives up to three prior successful question and validated-SQL pairs from the current browser session.
